description: This file defines a class 'Style' responsible for converting spreadsheet cell styles into OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS) XML format. It includes methods for mapping alignments, writing fill styles, cell properties, text properties, column and row styles, and overall table styles.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: Handles styling of spreadsheet cells for ODS format, converting PHPSpreadsheet style objects into the appropriate OpenDocument XML elements and attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Style object with an XMLWriter instance.

methods.name: mapHorizontalAlignment
methods.description: Maps PHPSpreadsheet horizontal alignment constants to ODS-specific string values.

methods.name: mapVerticalAlignment
methods.description: Maps PHPSpreadsheet vertical alignment constants to ODS-specific string values.

methods.name: writeFillStyle
methods.description: Writes the fill style (background color, gradient) to the XML writer.

methods.name: writeCellProperties
methods.description: Writes cell properties such as alignment, fill, and rotation.

methods.name: mapUnderlineStyle
methods.description: Returns the underline style string based on the Font's underline property.

methods.name: writeTextProperties
methods.description: Writes font and text-related properties such as bold, italic, color, font family, size, and underline style.

methods.name: writeColumnProperties
methods.description: Writes properties related to column dimensions.

methods.name: writeColumnStyles
methods.description: Defines a style for a column, including width.

methods.name: writeRowProperties
methods.description: Writes properties related to row height.

methods.name: writeRowStyles
methods.description: Defines a style for a row, including height.

methods.name: writeTableStyle
methods.description: Defines styles for the table overall, such as visibility.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Main method to write a cell style by composing different style components into XML.
